The absolute-trend gate is validated for this market (gate_helps true), so the trend-discipline leg is the only reliable edge. emerging_watch: Watching Big Banks (ZEB.TO) for a possible leadership handoff from Oil & Gas: the condition that would retire this watch is ZEB.TO closing above XEG.TO on a 10-day rolling relative return with the rotation margin (currently 0.46) compressing below 0.20. Until that happens, Oil & Gas remains the leader and this is not a call.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: XEG.TO is the only eligible, scorable theme with a strong positive score (1.317) and non-crowded positioning (crowding_z 0.19, crowded false). The absolute-trend gate (eligible true) supports participation, and the leadership margin over the next theme is wide enough to call it the prevailing narrative. However, the hurst_tag is mean-revert and durability_bar is only 0.41, suggesting the trend is not robust — lean but do not rely on continuation.
evidence: leader with margin 0.46 over Big Banks
theses.dissent: Mean-revert hurst tag plus low durability suggests the energy leadership is already stretched and likely to snap back, especially in a market where the detector's own track record shows poor direction accuracy.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO closes below its 50-day moving average before 20 trading days elapse

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: ZEB.TO is the challenger with the highest durability_bar in the top tier (0.70), full breadth (0.714), and non-crowded positioning. It is eligible under the absolute-trend gate and has a solid relative score (0.857). The rotation radar shows Oil & Gas as leader and Big Banks as the only credible challenger — a confirmed handoff is NOT yet visible, but the durability and breadth of Banks support a modest overweight as a resilient complement.
theses.dissent: The rotation margin is still wide (0.46) and broadening eligibility is narrowing — capital may remain concentrated in energy, leaving Banks with insufficient relative flow to outperform in the horizon window.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO underperforms XEG.TO by more than 3% over any 10-day stretch within the 20-day horizon

theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: XST.TO is the only theme in the top tier with a genuine trend tag (hurst_tag trend), perfect breadth (1.0), and the highest durability_bar of all themes (0.80). It is eligible under the absolute-trend gate, which is the validated risk-control leg. Crowding is flagged (crowding_z 1.02, crowded true), so this is a size-down caution, NOT a fade — but the theme's trend-health and breadth support a modest overweight in a risk-controlled framework.
theses.dissent: Crowding flag plus a tracking record that shows attention spikes mark tops suggests this theme may be at a local peak; the absolute-trend gate may not prevent a mean-revert drawdown in a crowded trend.

falsifier.text: XST.TO falls below its 20-day moving average and underperforms the S&P/TSX by 5% before 15 trading days elapse
